prompts.tree:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished transparent pixel-art landmark sprite for a cozy top-down fantasy town.
Image 1 is the existing LANTERN TREE to REPLACE, reference for identity and overall silhouette only. Image 2 is the town cottage STYLE reference: warm hand-painted pixel clusters, clear shading, readable details at native game scale.
Create a substantially more beautiful ancient Lantern Tree: broad, full rounded crown of layered emerald and olive leaf clusters, graceful twisting boughs, a sturdy golden-brown trunk with readable broad bark planes, and 10-14 distinct warm amber PAPER LANTERNS hanging on thin dark cords at different heights among the branches. The lanterns are compact crafted hexagonal/cylindrical paper lamps with tiny dark caps and gentle interior light. Cozy, welcoming village centerpiece; no face or eyes in the tree.
COMPOSITION IS FUNCTIONAL: transparent SQUARE canvas. The full tree occupies almost the entire square, centered, uncropped, with 3% air above and at the sides. Canopy occupies the upper 68-72% and spans 90% of the canvas. Trunk and gnarled roots are concentrated ONLY in the middle third of the bottom quarter. At the bottom 22% of canvas, all opaque trunk/root pixels must stay inside x=33% through66% of the image, so the roots fit the existing walkable plaza. Root tips form a natural flat planted baseline at y=98%. Do not spread roots all the way to the canopy edges.
Camera: front-facing orthographic, slightly elevated three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG view, no isometric diagonal. Lighting from upper left. Designed to reduce to360x360 pixels; crisp dark warm contour, intentional pixel clusters and strong readable masses. Sophisticated foliage clusters, a few clear highlights, warm bark with smooth planes rather than noisy dots. NO black hollow trunk, no eyes, no jack-o-lantern holes, no fungi, no extra props, no signs, no text.
GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, including gaps between boughs and lantern cords. No ground, grass base, terrain island, cast shadow, sky, vignette, frame, specks, floating effects or colored matte. One complete landmark, no surrounding scene.
prompts.rootgate:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a replacement transparent pixel-art sealed Root Gate landmark in a cozy top-down fantasy RPG.
Image 1 is the existing Root Gate: preserve its identity as one monumental sealed pointed STONE ARCH overtaken by thick ancient tree roots, with a pair of closed steel-gray carved doors and a small bronze/gold center lock. Image 2 is the town cottage STYLE and camera reference only.
Redraw the Root Gate with higher quality and cleaner material detail: individually readable cool gray stone voussoirs, weathered carving, warm brown roots twisting around the arch and climbing across the side masonry, small deliberate moss patches and a restrained crown of green leaves. Closed dark steel-blue doors, a few subtle symmetrical carved geometric motifs, bronze fittings and a single centered round lock. Clearly sealed and solid; no open passage, no magical portal glow, no writing. Root and stone shapes must be organized, with a clear beautiful silhouette and no random yellow clutter.
SQUARE frame, whole object fully visible and almost filling the square, upright front facing. Bottom base spans almost the entire frame width and sits on one flat planted baseline at y98%. Peak at y2%. Main door is about half the object's total width and 70% its height, with the door seam exactly centered. This object fills an existing6x6tile/240x240pixel building footprint; no overhanging hillside or terrain outside that footprint. Slightly elevated orthographic three-quarter top-down RPG camera, show stone cap tops, no isometric skew. Warm light upper left, crisp dark brown-purple pixel contours, deliberate medium-size pixel clusters, finely shaded carved stone and smooth root planes, cohesive with the cottage. Designed to reduce to240x240 native pixels.
Genuinely transparent alpha background, no ground, grass, dirt base, shadow, characters, text, border, grid, scenery, extra objects or colored matte.
prompts.boundaries:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production sprite atlas of connected rustic wooden fence and gate modules for the same cozy top-down fantasy town as the reference cottage. Reference image 1 is STYLE only; reference images2 and3 are the old fence/gate GEOMETRY only, replace their plain blocky finish.
Genuinely transparent PNG. EXACTLY THREE equal columns and THREE equal rows, nine separate complete assets total. Suggested canvas1536x1536, nine512x512 square cells. No text, grid, separators, ground or shadows. Each asset is centered in its own cell with a fixed lighting/camera and ample transparent spacing. Do not add any other pieces.
All pieces use the SAME attractive warm chestnut timber, beveled end grain, subtle wood-grain strokes, small iron nail heads, dark iron gate hinges, pale golden top-edge highlights and a restrained warm dark outline. Two horizontal rails at the same heights, square posts with small chamfered caps. Rich hand-painted PIXEL ART clusters and crisp edges like the cottage; no flat unshaded3D render or photorealism. Fence height reaches an RPG character's waist. The two rails have open transparent gaps between them. Keep the rails perfectly horizontal in front-facing pieces. No pointed pickets, no greenery, no rope or lantern accessories.
View is FRONT-FACING ORTHOGRAPHIC with a little elevated top-down depth, a north-south rail projects STRAIGHT VERTICALLY on the screen. Absolutely NOT diagonal isometric fences. Vertical pieces are clearly the SAME fence rotated90degrees on the ground plane, not a front-facing fence tipped on end.
CELL ORDER, left to right then next row:
TOP LEFT: straight horizontal fence section, two end posts and two connecting rails. Width about80%cell, height about70%cell. Rails reach both left and right ends, so neighboring copies connect.
TOP MIDDLE: same fence running straight north-south, very NARROW silhouette (20%cell width,85%height), near post lower on screen, far post higher; rails connect along the exact screen vertical axis. Keep the upper post cap visibly farther away.
TOP RIGHT: one matching SINGLE standalone capped wooden fence post, no rails. Width15%cell, height60%cell.
MIDDLE LEFT: CLOSED HORIZONTAL GATE, same capped end posts, two rails with one diagonal wooden brace, dark iron hinge straps on left, a small latch on right. Frontal upright panel, width80%cell height75%cell.
MIDDLE MIDDLE: the EXACT SAME horizontal gate OPEN, both posts stay in place but panel swings backwards around its left hinge, clearing a visible gap through the center. Leaves/rails are drawn narrowly in depth beside the left post, visibly open. Width80%cell height75%cell.
MIDDLE RIGHT: CLOSED VERTICAL/NORTH-SOUTH version of that wooden gate, a narrow foreshortened gate panel and posts arranged straight up and down the screen. Silhouette width30%cell, height85%cell.
BOTTOM LEFT: OPEN VERTICAL version of that same gate: posts stay at near/bottom and far/top, gate panel hinged to the far post swings towards screen-right, clearing the vertical passage. Fits width65%cell height85%cell.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: a connected90-degree fence CORNER with ONE centered cap post, short two-rail arms going screen RIGHT/EAST and screen UP/NORTH. Arms end at the cell's east and north joining points. No extra post at arm ends. Same rail heights/materials.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a connected90-degree fence CORNER with ONE centered cap post, short two-rail arms going screen RIGHT/EAST and screen DOWN/SOUTH. Arms end at east and south joining points. No extra post at arm ends. Same rail heights/materials.
Keep every piece fully inside its cell; consistent thickness and style. All holes and spaces transparent. NO text, numbers, labels, characters, terrain, flowers, scattered wood, grid lines, shadow or colored fringe.
